responseMessageContents.title: Fix text messaging service connection by using a more stable security key.
responseMessageContents.description: We worked on setting up a service to send text messages using Twilio. We ran into trouble because the security passwords kept changing and wouldn't let us log in. To fix this, we're switching to a different kind of security key that stays the same, ensuring the service stays connected and works correctly.
